questions.text: Scope: induction motors rated up to and including 11 kV.
This procedure does not apply to transformers, cables, generators or motors rated above 11 kV; such requests are out of scope and must be referred to the electrical authority.
Step 2 temperature correction: correct the measured resistance to 40 degrees Celsius by multiplying it by two raised to the power of (winding temperature minus 40) divided by 10.
